integrity: The infinite statements depend on the written proof and classical prime equidistribution, not on numerical tests; prior results and residual literature-coverage risk are acknowledged.
limitations: The exact density concerns prime bases, not all integers. The general result allows finitely many exceptional prime bases without a complete finite classification for m>=6; no bound on exceptional exponents is claimed. Independent external mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Prime-residue density and sharp low-index classifications for Schemmel iterate sums
